high_level_description: stc brand style, two Saudi men in red-and-white ghutras working at a bank of monitors in a dark control room displaying a world map and data charts.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark control room with wood-slat ceiling paneling, large wall-mounted screens showing a glowing globe and network diagrams, and rows of desks with multiple monitors.

elements.desc: A man wearing a white thobe and a red-and-white checkered ghutra, seated at a desk with several monitors showing line charts, typing on a keyboard.
A man wearing a red-and-white checkered ghutra, seated further back at another desk with a laptop.
A large wall screen displaying a glowing blue globe with data points, flanked by circular network diagrams.
